text_1308485034f1: Here you can find your route knowledge. Location knowledge and vehicle classes are prepared for future features.
text_24780c3c9616: Location knowledge features will follow later.
text_376cf04ec77f: Vehicle class features will follow later.
text_8562cceb9457: Open Route, class and location knowledge. The Route knowledge tab contains your existing map with the rail network, journey colours and age display. Location knowledge and Vehicle classes switch to the prepared areas. You cannot enter or save data there yet; the features will follow later. Switching tabs preserves the map, viewport and calculation.
text_8f6a274eb4f8: Route, class and location knowledge module with three tabs. The map is retained; additional features will follow later.
